notable_features.text: Swedish is a North Germanic language with a moderately sized phoneme inventory of 35 sounds and follows a subject-verb-object word order. It marks a relatively rich set of six tense/aspect categories, and as a North Germanic language it is the most widely spoken Germanic language in the Nordic countries.
